title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
content: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.

title: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
content: It comes after Moscow warned of "consequences" over the reported use of British drones by Ukraine.

title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
content: Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.

title: How US sanctions on Iran ripple through global markets and consumers
content: New sanctions hit Iran's aviation, tech, and shipping sectors, amplifying pressure on global markets and energy prices.

title: US Supreme Court sides with Trump administration on mail voting
content: Mail balloting has long been a favourite target of US President Donald Trump.

title: US removes Syria from ‘state sponsor of terrorism’ list
content: Washington also rescinded designation of HTS, formerly led by President Ahmed al-Sharaa, as a 'terrorist' organisation.
